title: process.yaml
description: process.yaml at the folder root of an exported module, a factory: a process template, with the texts a list of templates shows, the workspace type, the stack its workflows run on, the process document, the artifact types its workspaces use, the schema of the type settings of a run and the submit step of a run.

name.description: The template's name, at most 60 characters.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what a workspace made from the template does, at most 200 characters.

description.description: How a workspace made from the template works, at most 1200 characters and 80 words.

type.description: The workspace type a workspace made from the template has: a workspace type key, such as qory.software.

stack.description: The stack the template's workflows run on: a name that exports.stacks of the same repository lists. Each workflow of a stage is declared under workflows in that stack's qory-stack.yaml.

process.description: The process document of a workspace made from the template, a qory.process/v1 document. qory checks its schema, that its stages are a list, that each workflow of a stage is a non-empty string of one line that the stack declares, and that each stage name has no line break or other control character, and checks nothing else in it. This schema checks the same, except whether the stack declares a workflow.

name.description: A stage name has no line break or other control character.

artifact_types.description: The artifact types the template's workspaces use. Optional, and a list with no entries is valid. Each name is listed once, which qory checks and this schema cannot state. qory also checks that each json_schema compiles as a JSON Schema within the limits of the contract's README. qory has no list of standard types.

type_settings.description: The type settings of a run of a workspace made from the template: the settings that belong to the workspace type, which Qory Apiary sends in type_settings of the run documents. Optional: without it, the template registers no schema for them. qory checks that json_schema compiles as a JSON Schema within the limits of the contract's README, as it checks the json_schema of an artifact type, and checks no run's type settings against it.

json_schema.description: The JSON Schema of type_settings, such as one that requires full_suite in a software factory.

submit.description: The submit step of a run of a workspace made from the template. Optional: without it, the step stores no submission. At most one per file.

type.description: The artifact type of the submission: the name of a custom entry of artifact_types in the same file with base_view structured. qory checks that the entry is there, which this schema cannot state.

send.description: When the step sends the submission: end_of_run at the end of the run; after_gate after the gate of the run's stage passes, and until then the step stores the submission and sends nothing.

artifact_type.description: An artifact type: a standard type by its name alone, or a custom type with its full definition. Either may set withdrawable.

name.description: Lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens, 1 to 64 bytes.

base_view.description: How a version's files are shown, and what they must be.

size_limit.description: The most bytes of all files of one version.

max_files.description: The most files of one version.

json_schema.description: The JSON Schema of a structured type's file.

withdrawable.description: Whether a run may withdraw a name of the type. Optional, and true when the entry has none. A standard type and a custom type may both set it.

oneOf.description: A standard type: the name alone, or the name and withdrawable.

custom_structured.description: A structured type has one file, and the one base view with a json_schema.

workflow.description: A workflow of a stage: a string of one line, not empty or white space alone, that the stack declares under workflows.
